methodology.purpose: Publish attributable assessments and technical measurements without converting a single source into a KINGAI verdict.
rules: Technical research retains its measurement scope.
UN allegations and concerns are not judicial findings.
Public social and web discourse has direct score weight 0.

assessments.summary_en: Freedom House rates China 9/100 and Not Free in Freedom in the World 2026.
assessments.summary_zh: Freedom House 在《2026 年世界自由度》中给予中国 9/100，并评为“不自由”。

assessments.summary_en: Freedom House rates China's internet freedom 9/100 and Not Free for the 2025 reporting cycle.
assessments.summary_zh: Freedom House 在 2025 年网络自由报告中给予中国 9/100，并评为“不自由”。

assessments.summary_en: RSF ranks China 178th of 180 in the 2026 World Press Freedom Index with a score of 13.85/100.
assessments.summary_zh: RSF 在 2026 年世界新闻自由指数中将中国列为 180 个国家和地区中的第 178 位，得分 13.85/100。

assessments.publisher: GFW Report / IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2025
assessments.summary_en: A 2025 peer-reviewed measurement study documents a provincial censorship system in Henan using TLS SNI and HTTP Host filtering alongside the national Great Firewall; the study reports about 4.2 million cumulatively blocked domains during its measurement period.
assessments.summary_zh: 2025 年同行评审测量研究记录了河南省级网络审查系统，使用 TLS SNI 与 HTTP Host 过滤并与全国性 GFW 并存；研究称其测量期内累计封锁约 420 万个域名。

assessments.summary_en: A USENIX Security 2025 measurement study reports that the Great Firewall began blocking QUIC connections to selected domains and characterizes SNI-based filtering of QUIC traffic.
assessments.summary_zh: USENIX Security 2025 测量研究称，中国防火长城开始对特定域名的 QUIC 连接实施封锁，并分析了针对 QUIC 流量的基于 SNI 的过滤机制。

assessments.summary_en: GreatFire's July 30, 2026 monitoring snapshot reports 708,135 analyzed URLs and 130,831 blocked URLs; 29% of URLs with conclusive verdicts in its monitored set were classified as blocked. This describes its monitored sample, not all websites.
assessments.summary_zh: GreatFire 在 2026 年 7 月 30 日的监测快照中报告分析了 708,135 个 URL，其中 130,831 个被判定为封锁；其有明确判定的监测样本中约 29% 被归类为封锁。该数据描述其监测样本，并非整个互联网。

assessments.summary_en: OONI reports that F-Droid has been blocked in China since June 2023, with measurements across multiple networks indicating DNS injection; its findings page currently labels the block ongoing.
assessments.summary_zh: OONI 报告称 F-Droid 自 2023 年 6 月起在中国遭到封锁，多网络测量显示存在 DNS 注入；其当前发现页面仍将该封锁标为持续中。

assessments.summary_en: HRW's 2026 China chapter reports systematic restrictions on expression, association, assembly and religion, and describes extensive censorship and surveillance.
assessments.summary_zh: 人权观察 2026 年中国章节报告称，中国存在对言论、结社、集会和宗教自由的系统性限制，并描述了广泛的审查与监控。

assessments.summary_en: Amnesty International's China 2025 report says authorities intensified control over information and public discourse and continued suppressing dissent and peaceful assembly.
assessments.summary_zh: 国际特赦组织 2025 年中国报告称，当局加强对信息与公共话语的控制，并继续压制异议与和平集会。

assessments.summary_en: Recent UN Special Procedures communications to China include allegations involving arbitrary detention, disappearances and restrictions on freedom of opinion and expression. These are allegation/concern records, not judicial findings.
assessments.summary_zh: 联合国特别程序近年的对华函件包含有关任意拘留、失踪及限制意见和表达自由的指称与关切。这些属于指称/关切记录，不是司法判决。

assessments.summary_en: China's cyberspace regulator states that the country's personal-information protection framework and enforcement continued to strengthen during 2025.
assessments.summary_zh: 中国国家网信办发布的《2025 年个人信息保护报告》称，中国个人信息保护制度体系与执法工作在 2025 年继续加强。
